svg.title: MILP with a terminal SoC value learned by fitted Q iteration
svg.desc: Five modules from input to output: published SMARD prices feed an XGBoost forecaster; an offline reward cache trains fitted Q iteration, whose terminal SoC value enters the 24 h MILP; the day plan is settled at realised prices in a chained backtest and compared with the ISEA index.
